meta.title: Purchase Contract quantity above the PR's open quantity

plan.title: Purchase Contract Quantity Above PR Open Quantity

steps.note: Open Purchase Requisitions as the starting point for selecting an eligible open PR.
Ensure the PR list is on the Open tab, where the required PR line can be found.

args.goal: Find an eligible open purchase requisition, open its purchase contract flow, enter a contracted quantity greater than the selected PR line's open quantity, and stop with Procol's refusal visible.

steps.note: The catalog has no dedicated Purchase Contract quantity-entry step, so perform this buyer-side flow on screen and stop when the validation is shown.

args.text: Contracted quantity cannot exceed PR open quantity

steps.note: Assert the exact refusal required by the test case.
